# Spott.ca

> Spott.ca is Canada's modern business directory — discover, review, and connect with verified local businesses across the country.

Spott helps Canadians find trustworthy local businesses (restaurants, beauty, health, home services, automotive, professional services, retail, events) and lets owners claim and grow their listings.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and discover verified local Canadian businesses.
- [Browse](/browse): Filter businesses by category, city, and keyword.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans for business owners — Free, Pro, and Business tiers.
- [Add your business](/new-listing): Owners can create an AI-assisted listing.
- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Customer and business owner accounts.
